---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

Batting |> 
  group_by(playerID) |> 
  summarize(
    total_HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID)
  ) |> 
  slice_max(total_HR, n = 15) |> 
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |> 
  mutate(
    name = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    steroid_era = if_else(
      last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
      "Active",
      "Not Active"
    )
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = total_HR, y = fct_reorder(name, total_HR), fill = steroid_era)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 Career Home Run Leaders and the Steroid Era",
    x = "Career Home Runs",
    y = "Player",
    fill = "Steroid Era (1994–2009)",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  )
```

```{r}
Batting |> 
  group_by(playerID) |> 
  summarize(
    total_HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID)
  ) |> 
  slice_max(total_HR, n = 15) |> 
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |> 
  mutate(
    name = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    span = paste0(first_year, "–", last_year)
  ) |> 
  select(name, total_HR, span) |> 
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Player", "Career Home Runs", "Span of Seasons")
  )
```

```{r}
Batting |> 
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = HR)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  )
```
